# kitsu 狐

> A multi-gateway LLM CLI written in Rust. Talk to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
> — OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Ollama, vLLM, or a custom gateway — through
> one configurable interface, with an agent tool-loop, a Claude-Code-style
> permission model for filesystem tools, and model-aware context management.

kitsu is a Cargo workspace of five crates:

- `kitsu` — the CLI binary: `ask` (one-shot) and `chat` (interactive REPL), config
  and gateway-profile resolution, the permission prompt, and project-context
  loading.
- `kitsu-core` — the agent orchestrator loop (call model → run tools → repeat) and
  context management (token budgeting, trimming cascade).
- `kitsu-providers` — the `Provider` trait and the OpenAI-compatible streaming
  client shared by every gateway.
- `kitsu-tools` — the tool registry, runtime `Permissions`, and built-in
  filesystem tools (`fs_read_file`, `fs_list_dir`, `repo_grep`, `fs_write_file`).
- `kitsu-render` — terminal rendering (banner, spinner, streamed output).
